semantic.justification: Consumed paragraph/run groups, native CR finish protocol, three script families, typed character/paragraph properties and style toggle semantics. Imported-style values are read through DomainMapper_Impl, not Writer pooled-style UNO defaults. The represented non-numbered paragraph/run slice is partial; style application, numbering/table/section/theme managers and unconsumed property cases remain pending. Whole-module parity stays unverified and DOCX application/UI import/export is not yet established. V4DQJW adds original kern modifier boolean projection nIntValue !=0, preserving the native minimum-size-threshold collapse (WRITER125). Word-only underline retains its separate true-only insertion and later-type behavior (WRITER126). The actual native item pool/UNO/primary storage path is now supported for these two bool properties.
